title: Linear Function Graph
description: A single line in the xy-plane, drawn from slope m and y-intercept b. Serves the Algebra domain (linear-functions, linear-equations-two-vars): stems reference the same m and b as the figure, e.g. slope/interpretation and point-on-line questions.

slope.description: Slope m of y = mx + b. Use SAT-clean values (integers or simple halves/thirds).

yIntercept.description: Y-intercept b; must lie inside the grid so the line visibly crosses the y-axis.

markedPoints.description: Points dotted and labeled on the line; each must satisfy y = slope*x + yIntercept (renderer validates).

showIntercepts.description: Dot the axis intercepts without textual labels.

notes: Renderer guarantees: integer grid lines at every unit within xRange and symmetric y-extent computed from the line; axes with arrows; marked points are validated to lie on the line and are auto-offset so labels never overlap the line or each other; slope of 0 draws a horizontal line (allowed); the line always spans the full visible grid.
